rounds.claim: On 8 November 2026, Abuja is the capital of Nigeria.
Lagos is the largest city in Nigeria.
Lagos is a former capital of Nigeria. Abuja replaced it in 1991.
Lagos lies about 6.46 degrees north of the equator.
Lagos lies about 3.39 degrees east of Greenwich.
Abuja lies about 9.06 degrees north of the equator.
